name: Palovarotene

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States

examples.title: An Efficacy and Safety Study of Palovarotene for the Treatment of MO
examples.why: Trial was terminated early to analyze the accumulated data and evaluate the efficacy, safety and future of palovarotene in MO.

examples.title: In-Home Evaluation of Episodic Administration of Palovarotene in Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva (FOP) Subjects
examples.why: Subjects were enrolled into a different Phase 2 study (PVO-1A-202, NCT02279095).

summary: In the United States, palovarotene carries a boxed warning, which is the most prominent safety warning on a drug label [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a medium risk score of 64 for the liver and a low risk score of 24 for the heart [M]. Additionally, one clinical study of the drug was stopped early so researchers could evaluate safety, efficacy, and future use [5], while another trial stopped because participants were moved into a different study [6].
